candidates.label: positive
candidates.rationale: PK customer IDs are unique; set difference removes exactly customers with a paid order.
candidates.sql: SELECT id FROM customers EXCEPT SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status='paid'

candidates.label: positive
candidates.rationale: Intersection of distinct customer sets requires each SKU without requiring a shared order.
candidates.sql: SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o JOIN lines l ON l.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status='paid' AND l.sku='A' INTERSECT SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o JOIN lines l ON l.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status='paid' AND l.sku='B'

candidates.label: positive
candidates.rationale: Set difference ignores nullable unassigned IDs because no positive agent PK equals NULL.

candidates.label: positive
candidates.rationale: Correlated ordered first element implements earliest date/least ID, with existence excluding no-reply tickets.
candidates.sql: SELECT t.id,(SELECT e.id FROM events e WHERE e.ticket_id=t.id AND e.kind='reply' ORDER BY e.happened_on,e.id LIMIT 1) FROM tickets t WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.ticket_id=t.id AND e.kind='reply')

candidates.label: positive
candidates.rationale: Nonempty invoice-owner set minus owners with any positive invoice balance enforces both clauses.
candidates.sql: SELECT account_id FROM invoices EXCEPT SELECT i.account_id FROM invoices i WHERE i.total_cents > COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_cents) FROM payments p WHERE p.invoice_id=i.id),0)

candidates.label: positive
candidates.rationale: Date/PK ordering has unique peers, so RANGE includes exactly the same prefix as ROWS.
candidates.sql: SELECT invoice_id,id,SUM(amount_cents) OVER(PARTITION BY invoice_id ORDER BY paid_on,id RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM payments ORDER BY invoice_id,paid_on,id

candidates.label: negative
